acceptance: A read-only command reports the Databricks table quota with its refresh time, and lists BenchBox-created schemas with their table counts
A documented, owner-approved procedure (not automatic) reclaims tables from finished benchmark schemas without touching non-BenchBox objects
Run preflight uses the same quota reading and records its refresh age
context: Found during the live-cloud corpus publication. Preflight readings are in `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/held-cloud-reruns-20261003/*.preflight.json`, with the guard-stop record in `databricks_clickbench_sf1_safe.preflight-guard440-stop.json`.
description: The workspace metastore table count rose from 392 to 442 of a 500-table quota during the 19 Databricks reruns on 2026-10-03. Each new benchmark and scale schema adds its tables, and dropped tables still count for about seven days. The run lane's guard (at most 440, raised to 460 by the owner) stopped the lane once, with six cells left. No BenchBox tooling reports per-schema table usage or reclaims tables from finished benchmark schemas. So future campaigns rely on ad hoc guards and may hit the quota. The quota reading itself can be hours old (`last_refreshed_at`).
